name: roblox-agent-kit
description: One install that gives Claude Code the whole Roblox toolchain: Roblox Studio's built-in MCP server, an Open Cloud + docs MCP server, Luau lint/type-check hooks, Rojo/Wally/luau-lsp/selene/StyLua/Lune project scaffolding, and playbook skills.

roblox_api_key.title: Roblox Open Cloud API key (optional)
roblox_api_key.description: Used only by the roblox-cloud MCP tools (Luau Execution, place upload, read-only DataStores). Create at create.roblox.com/dashboard/credentials with the scopes listed in the README. Leave empty to skip cloud features.

universe_id.title: Default universe (experience) ID (optional)
universe_id.description: Fallback universe ID for Open Cloud tools when the project has no roblox-kit.json.

place_id.title: Default place ID (optional)
place_id.description: Fallback place ID for Open Cloud tools when the project has no roblox-kit.json.
